scoring_rule: Domain scores are conservative rollups of AP_E0_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.csv. ADEQUATE requires the domain minimum to be in-hand. Failure to obtain coupling evidence is UNRESOLVED coupling, not weak coupling. No model results. Item-level ACCESS_STATUS is independent of SCIENTIFIC_STATUS: obtaining a file never implies ADEQUATE.

status_separation.ACCESS_STATUS: Whether a source/file was obtained. Values: NOT_OBTAINED | OBTAINED | ACCESS_REQUIRED | UNAVAILABLE | ERROR.
status_separation.SCIENTIFIC_STATUS: Whether obtained evidence clears the corresponding frozen E0 blocker. Values: ADEQUATE | PARTIAL | INADEQUATE | NOT_ASSESSABLE. NOT_ASSESSABLE is used when ACCESS_STATUS is not OBTAINED and no in-hand incomplete evidence exists to score against.

E0.1.name: spatial identity
E0.1.summary: GWRA 2024 PDF reports 679 assessment units and a 2023-24 vintage, but machine-readable polygons, stable IDs, and the 679-versus-667 revenue-mandal crosswalk are not in-hand. AP_SPATIAL_UNIT_STATUS remains UNRESOLVED.

E0.2.name: monitoring-well identity
E0.2.summary: 71,384 spatial-QA-usable OBSERVED quarterly depths exist (1996-01-05 to 2023-08-20). AP GWD telemetry CSVs are now in-hand (six-hourly, 2021-2026) but are name-keyed: no stable station IDs, aquifer/layer, monitoring-versus-pumping flag, QA, or populated RL_MSL. Public heads do not clear the identity blocker.

E0.3.name: withdrawal forcing
E0.3.summary: Only statewide annual ESTIMATED GWRA extraction (7.88 bcm/y) is in-hand. Annual totals are inadequate for dynamic identification. Target cadence is monthly or finer; scientific minimum is subannual adequacy versus aquifer timescale, head cadence, and analogue. No meter/estimate class table exists. Do not estimate synthetic sigma.
blocking_items: meter vs estimate vs proxy class

E0.4.name: recharge forcing
E0.4.summary: IMD 0.25-degree daily rainfall (Pai et al. 2014) is identified; years 1996, 2020, and 2023 were downloaded as product samples. That does not complete the 1996-2023 overlap or join rainfall to 679 units. Statewide annual ESTIMATED recharge (27.80 bcm/y) remains the only recharge total in-hand. No recharge-component panel independent of pumping exists. GRACE was not downloaded and is never well-level ground truth.

E0.5.name: hydrogeological coupling evidence
E0.5.summary: No pumping tests, interference tests, transmissivity, storage, machine-readable NAQUIM GIS, or documented cross-well effects are in-hand. Yearbook PDF is network/cadence context and is not scored as unit-level coupling. COUPLING_STATUS remains UNRESOLVED. Failure to detect coupling is not weak coupling.

E0.6.name: temporal overlap / excitation
E0.6.summary: Quarterly heads span 1996-2023 and AP GWD telemetry heads span 2021-2026, but there is still no overlapping subannual withdrawal forcing. Aquifer-response timescale is unknown without T/S/tests. No intervention analogue is documented. Head cadence alone does not establish excitation.

coupling.rule: NOT_DETECTED != WEAK. Evidence of material coupling would invalidate the local all-node family. No path to empirical M1N.

pumping_cadence_rule.scientific_minimum: subannual forcing whose cadence is demonstrably adequate relative to aquifer-response timescale, head-observation cadence, and intervention analogue

intervention_analogue.LEVEL_C: observational held-out variation; not causal/intervention identification

STATIC_ONLY_ELIGIBLE_reason: M0S still blocked on unit polygons/IDs, unit-level GWRA tables, candidates, and source feasibility. Statewide GWRA aggregates are static context, not a runnable M0S. Dynamics are also not frozen STATIC_ONLY because coupling and forcing absences are missing-data, not a completed hydrogeologic finding.
BLOCKERS: E0.1 679 assessment-unit polygons and stable IDs
E0.2 station master (ID, aquifer, monitoring vs pumping, datum)
E0.3 subannual well/node pumping with meter/estimate/proxy class
E0.4 rainfall and recharge components independent of pumping
E0.5 strong hydrogeologic coupling evidence (tests, T/S, NAQUIM GIS, documented neighbour response)

public_acquisition_pass.note: Public telemetry heads, IMD rainfall samples, and NAQUIM PDFs were obtained. ACCESS_STATUS=OBTAINED never implies SCIENTIFIC_STATUS=ADEQUATE. No E0 blocker cleared.
